sentences.text: This is first application filed under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 06.06.2025 in connection with Crime No.88/2025 registered at Police Station - Satanwada, District - Shivpuri, (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 419, 467, 468,
471, 120B of IPC and Section 3/4 of the Examination Act.

2. The allegation against the present applicant/accused is that he was the original candidate who had applied for the post advertised and he along with other co-accused persons committed fraud in the recruitment test examination for the post of Constable in the Madhya Pradesh Police, 2023 by way of making repeated changes in the Adhar Credentials and he managed to sit some other person in the aforesaid examination in place of him.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Under similar set of facts and allegations many other accused NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:25047 2 MCRC-39671-2025 of the same examination have already been enlarged on bail by this C o u r t .
Investigation is over and charge-sheet has already been filed.
Therefore, custodial interrogation is no more required.
Applicant is the permanent resident of District Gwalior (M.P.), therefore, there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
Applicant undertakes to cooperate in trial as well as investigation and would make himself available as and when required.
Under these grounds, counsel for applicant prayed for bail.
3. Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/State vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its dismissal.
